tools.name: penny_get_skill
tools.description: Read the current Penny operating skill when session start reports a stale or missing installed copy. Default returns only SKILL.md; use file for a reference path from manifest when its cue applies. Use view:install after user approval for an exact installation archive and per-file hashes. Retain res

tools.name: penny_start_setup
tools.description: Run the first-run setup interview with the user. Returns a short interview script (how to address them, who they are, communication preferences, current focus) for you to ask conversationally and save with penny_write (entityType:"profile"), plus a custom-instructions snippet for the user to paste i

tools.name: penny_session_start
tools.description: Before calling, read the installed Penny skill and report installedSkillStatus (versioned, unversioned, or missing), installedSkillVersion and installedSkillSha256 from its metadata when versioned, and installedSkillSource. If this host cannot install skills, report missing/unsupported. Do not guess

tools.name: penny_edit
tools.description: When the user corrects something on file, or a task, tracker, skill, or block needs to change, edit the existing item rather than writing a duplicate. Modify something that already exists in the user's memory, chosen by `entityType` — same taxonomy as `penny_write` (see its ladder). Notes take `upda

tools.name: penny_delete
tools.description: Move to Trash. Project: projectId + expectedRevision + operationId; penny_edit op:restore recovers. Repeat in_progress with the same operationId; report partial_recovery conflicts. Note/tracker_entry: ids (max100); skill/rhythm: one id; profile_block: ids are block names. Tag/link removal uses the i

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "penny_session_start" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Before calling, read the installed Penny skill and report installedSkillStatus (versioned, unversioned, or missing), installedSkillVersion and installedSkillSha…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "penny_session_start" stacks urgency/override words (never, attention). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
